notes: Fixed the focal path/join ordering to follow the assigned route exactly (CONVERSATION -> CONVERSATION_MEMBERSHIP -> USER -> REACTION -> MESSAGE), i.e. channels -> channel_members -> users -> message_reactions -> messages, rather than starting from messages. This yields the correct two-channel match set (C03IJKL9012, C_INFRA) since message.channel_id is implicitly tied back to the root channel via the shared entity identity. Two legitimate alternative channels both satisfy the criterion: a member named Robert left an eyes reaction on a circuit-tracer OOM rewrite message, matching the design's underspecified resolution. The pre-existing bot eyes-reaction on the same engineering message (U01AGENBOT9) is retained unchanged as the canonical 'wrong reactor, same message' negative, per binding_note. C02EFGH5678 (Robert Walsh member, no reactions there) and C_MODEL (Robert Chen's wrong-channel, wrong-emoji reaction) are flagged as plausible but incorrect root-channel candidates. Base-seed noise messages 1706110000.000200/.000300 (Robert Chen, Kenji posting in C03IJKL9012 despite not being members there) are left untouched as pre-existing seed inconsistencies unrelated to this construction, per the design's explicit instruction.
